metadata.title: एक जंगली खुंभी की ख़ास कहानी | The Story of A Special Wild Mushroom
metadata.description: In the dense forests of Jharkhand, Chhattisgarh, West Bengal, and Madhya Pradesh, a rare and seasonal delicacy known as Rugda Mushroom thrives. Locally referred to as Putu, Jhamir, or Latad, this wild mushroom is not only celebrated for its unique and rich flavor but is also a powerhouse of nutrition. Often found during the early monsoon season, Rugda is foraged by tribal communities and holds deep cultural and economic significance. Watch the full story of this exceptional mushroom — a gift from nature that brings together taste, tradition, and health.
